title: Victoria Kayak - Tours & Rentals
specs: Located in downtown Victoria Harbour near Empress Hotel and BC Legislature
Wildlife sightings include harbour seals, great blue heron, river otters, and occasionally orcas
Tours use stable ocean-going kayaks with safety briefings and instruction
Children under 14 must be accompanied by an adult unless waived for groups
Children under 4 can ride in special triple kayak with two adults
Pre-teen children can paddle double kayak with adult
Children 14 and older can manage single kayak
Groups of 7 or more considered private bookings
Group rates available by calling or emailing

variants.label: Guided kayak tours exploring Victoria Harbour and marine wildlife

includes: Snack bar and water bottle on kayak tours
Hybrid-style bicycle, helmet, and water bottle on bike tour
gap: Exact prices for rentals and combined tours not stated
blurb: Guests can take guided kayak tours to explore Victoria's marine wildlife and historic waterways or rent kayaks for self-guided adventures. Tours include safety briefings and equipment, with options for single, double, and triple kayaks. The business also offers combined kayak and bike tours.
extraNote: Group bookings of 7+ require 7 days notice for cancellation or modification · 50% deposit required at booking for group bookings, balance due 7 days prior · Final group numbers must be confirmed 7 days prior or full charges apply · Reservations can be booked online with as little as 12 hours notice · Weather may cause route changes; guides choose safest route · Main Office and floating docks on the Miners Landing Pier, downtown Victoria
